summary: Frontend-only testing of Session 66 'Aktuelles & Finanzwissen' (HomeFinancialArticles + /finanzwissen/:slug). Verified section render, eyebrow/headline, featured card (image/title/excerpt/'Artikel lesen'), 2 secondary teasers, all 7 filter chips with client-side filtering (all=11, aktien=2, etfs-fonds=0 -> empty state, maerkte=1, finanzwissen=4; featured stays outside grid and always visible), card navigation to detail page, detail page structure (back link, h1 title, 3 content blocks), related-article navigation, invalid slug redirect to / without 404, CTA -> /wissen, responsive column counts (mobile 1 / tablet 2 / desktop 3, no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint, filter chips wrap into 3 rows on 390px), route regression (/, /wissen, /handeln, /fonds-grundlagen, /finanzwissen/tagesgeld-oder-festgeld all HTTP 200, exactly 1 h1 each), homepage regression (BankingHero, HomeNewsPreview, HomeInvestmentSpectrum + 6 wizard 'Fragen beantworten' buttons, bonus-cta-section all present) and zero pageerrors. Two real defects found: one 404 Unsplash image used by two articles, and missing related-articles section for single-article categories (incl. the featured article).

ui_bugs.issue: Unsplash URL 'photo-1590283603385-c1c67c40d0d4' returns HTTP 404 -> broken/empty image placeholder for articles 'aktien-fuer-einsteiger' (line 194) and 'anleihen-rendite-und-kurs' (line 334), both on the home grid card and on the article detail hero. Verified 2 broken imgs of 14 in section (naturalWidth=0). Also the same photo id is reused for two different articles (duplicate imagery).

getRelatedFinancialArticles() only matches the same category with no fallback. Categories with a single article (etfs-fonds = the FEATURED article, sparen, maerkte) render zero related items, so [data-testid=finanzwissen-article-related] is completely absent on /finanzwissen/etfs-verstehen-worauf-anleger-achten-sollten (the flagship article) — dead end for the most prominent entry point. Suggest filling up to 3 with latest articles from other categories.

issues: Right column of the featured row (only 2 secondary teasers) ends far above the tall featured card, leaving a large empty gap (~250px+) next to the featured image; consider a 3rd teaser or vertical distribution.

Filter 'ETFs & Fonds' always yields the empty state because the only etfs-fonds article is the featured one which is excluded from the grid — looks like a bug to users; either include the featured article in that filter result or add a second etfs-fonds article.

action_items: Replace the 404 Unsplash image id 'photo-1590283603385-c1c67c40d0d4' with two distinct working images for 'aktien-fuer-einsteiger' and 'anleihen-rendite-und-kurs'.
Add a cross-category fallback to getRelatedFinancialArticles so every article (especially the featured ETF article) shows a Weiterlesen section.
Decide behaviour for the 'ETFs & Fonds' filter (currently always empty state) — add an etfs-fonds article or include the featured item in filtered results.
critical_code_review_comments: financialArticles.js: no runtime validation/dedup of image URLs — a single 404 id silently degrades two cards; consider a shared IMAGES map and unique assets per article.
HomeFinancialArticles.jsx: article uses alt="" (decorative) for the featured/secondary/grid cards; acceptable since the title link carries the text, but headline-derived alt would be better for SEO.
Filter state is not reflected in the URL/hash, so a filtered view cannot be shared or restored after navigating to a detail page and back.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (17/18 checks passed; 1 broken image asset + 1 missing related section)
